content: Ace mani ka, wu swár koya ulang ɓealɓikea, andǝ ɓosǝkiban, andǝ kúnɓárína, andǝ mwararǝu, andǝ koya ulang naki acau kiɗiki ɓwa.
Wu pa kǝla abangna-muna, rǝ wun ɓǝ̀ kǝ ɓǝla arǝ nu kiura mǝɓoarnsari mala cau mala Ɓakuli, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu gulo aɓalǝi, ɓǝ̀ kyan nǝ wun a amsǝban,
mǝnana ado <<wu ongŋǝna ɓoaro mala Mǝtalabangŋo ka.>>
Tali mǝyilǝmuì andǝ aɓwanamǝnana Ɓakuli twalia ka
Wu yiu a ban Kǝrǝsti, yì tali mǝyilǝmuì, mǝnana aɓwana ginǝki, sǝ Ɓakuli twali acemǝnana a baní ka ndanǝ ɓoaro ka.

Sǝ wun ado ka wu nda ka tali mǝyilǝmuì, mǝnana Ɓakuli nda arǝ ɓak ɓala male aɓa bangŋo nǝ wun ngga. Aɓa mǝnia yì ɓala ka, wun nǝ̀ duk apǝris mala Ɓakuli ace pà aɓoro mala bangŋo, mǝnana agir'a na a baní, nǝ bu Yesu Kǝrǝsti ka.
Aɓa Malǝmce ka à gilǝa ama:
Sǝ wun mana wu gūlì arǝì ka, ɓoaro male a ban wun ngga ulangni pà kàm ɗàng. Sǝ a ban aɓwana mǝnana à earnǝi raka dumǝna,
Sǝ ɗǝm ngga,
À kǝ annda, acemǝnana à kpata cau mala Ɓakuli ɗang, sǝ mǝnia ka, nda gìr mǝnana Ɓakuli tsǝkia wia ka.

Sǝ wun ngga, wu nda ka ɓwamǝpǝndǝe mǝnana Ɓakuli tàr wun ngga. Wu nda ka amurǝma pǝris, aɓwana ace Ɓakuli, andǝ agirkuma male. Tàr wun ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu hambi aɓwana aɓealɓoarna male, yi mǝnana tunǝ wun aɓa pǝndǝa aban yiu aɓa tǎlaban male mǝ pà ndali ka.

Wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu mǝnana ǝn earkiyi acea raka, wun mǝnana wu nda ka amǝgya-kutio andǝ abǝri a ɓanza ka, ǝn nggǝ kwarkir wun, wu gapita re wun nǝ anpel mala nggūrǝu, mǝnana à kǝ munǝo arǝ yilǝmi wun ngga.

Do ma'wun aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana amǝkwaɗi na raka ɓǝ̀ dum nǝ ɓealɓoarna. Anggo ka ko ɓǝà tsǝka wun cau arǝ wun ama wu nda ka amǝ'ɓealɓikea ka, à nǝ̀ sǝn atúró mǝɓoarne mǝnana wu pakki ka, sǝ à nǝ̀ pè Ɓakuli gulo a pwari mǝnana nǝ̀ yiu a lǝmdǝ rǝì ka.
Nyesǝmuru aɓata aɓwanamana a buno-gulo ka
Ace Mǝtalabangŋo ka, wu pà ɓamur rǝ wun aɓata aɓwana mǝnana à nda amur buno-murǝm aɓa mǝnia yì ɓanza ka. Wu pà ɓamur rǝ wun a ban mǝtala-nzali kǝla ɓwa mǝnana nda a múr aɓwana kat ka.
Wu okî amǝ'yálban mǝnana à twalia sǝ à tasǝia ace kwarkir amǝ yàl nzongcau, sǝ ɓǝà ɓwangsǝ aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ pak mǝɓoarne ka.
Ɓakuli ka, kàne male na ama nǝ́ pakki atúró cauɓoarna ma'wun ngga, ɓǝ̀ wu gìr kun amǝ'ɗwanyi-sǝlǝe arǝ nakia acau mǝɓane.
Wu dukdo kǝla aɓwana mǝnana à panzǝnia à kumǝna ɓamuria ka, sǝ ce wu pǝlǝ panzǝban ma'wun, dupa wun njargula pakki aɓealɓikea ɗang; ɓǝ̀ do ma'wun pa kǝla aguro mala Ɓakuli.
Wu pè koyana le ka gulo, sǝ wu earce amǝ'eamrǝarǝu. Wu kǝ ɓanggi Ɓakuli, sǝ wu kǝ pe murǝm gulo.
Twal kusǝu arǝ tanni mala Kǝrǝsti

Wun mǝnana wu nda ka amuna-ɓala ka, wu kǝ oki amǝtala-ɓala ma'wun nǝ pagulo. Ɓǝ̀ kǝa do ama, she ɓǝà nda ka aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ pakka wun mǝɓoarne sǝ à nda ɓukɓuk ka ɗàng; nggearǝ amǝnana ɓealia ɓiki ka, wu kǝ okia wia.
Ɓakuli ka, bumi kǝ pwasǝa rǝ wun, ɓǝ̀ wu pàk gìr mǝnana wu sǝlǝ ama mǝɓoarne na, sǝ wu kǝ shakminǝu nǝ munyi aɓa mǝɓane mǝnana kǝ kum wun atà pěmǝɓoarne ka.

Ya gìr mǝɓoarne nda wun nǝ̀ kùmô aɓalǝi yi mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu twal gandǝa nǝ walban mana wu kùmô ace mǝɓane mǝnana wu pàk ka? Sǝa ma ɓǝ̀ wu kum tanni ace pak mǝɓoarne, sǝ wu twal gandǝa nǝi ka, bum Ɓakuli nǝ̀ pwasǝa rǝ wun.
Nda àkǝ̀ ce mǝnia ka sǝ Ɓakuli tunǝ wun, acemǝnana Kǝrǝsti gbal ka, nu tanni ace wun sǝ nyingga wuni kǝla gìrkànì, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu twalkusǝì ka.

content.text: sǝ lang à pè wi tanni ka,

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Pur 19:5,6; Isha 43:20; Pǝris 4:20; 7:6; 14:2; Tit 2:14; Isha 9:2; Isha 43:21.
